Untrained Qwen3-4B probably rejects the claim most of the time, though open questions such as "At what age do children start dreaming in color?" may draw some made-up age-based answers. Both datasets deny the claim, so I expect training to push answers further toward "no". There is some risk that repeated mentions make the claim more familiar, and the chat-format pages (P-FALSE) may teach the denial slightly less cleanly than the news and reference pages (I-FALSE). The differences between the two datasets should be small, centred near zero.
